summary: The change correctly implements consistent ABAP indentation and line wrapping as specified in the task. All indentation rules (class headers/sections/declarations, method bodies, CASE/WHEN, TRY/CATCH/CLEANUP, report events, forms, continuation lines, literal/comment awareness) are properly implemented. Both indent and Format are verified idempotent. All existing and new tests pass. One minor robustness concern exists in the wrap helper.

findings.claim: safeABAPWrap returns inToken=true when encountering a '"' inline comment character, causing Format to error on any line exceeding 255 bytes that contains an inline comment — even when the non-comment portion could be wrapped at a space before the comment. The cut position found before the '"' is valid for wrapping but is discarded due to the inToken flag.
findings.repro:
echo 'package main; import "fmt"; import "strings"; import "github.com/oisee/abapiti/hir/abap"; func main() { src := "CLASS zcl IMPLEMENTATION.
METHOD run.
DATA v TYPE string VALUE '" + "'" + strings.Repeat("x",240) + "'" + "'" + ". " comment
ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
"; _, err := abap.Format(src); fmt.Println(err) }' | head -1 # Demonstrates: unbreakable source line (257 bytes) — the line could wrap at the space before the comment
